```sql
WITH win_counts AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        winner AS team,
        COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM matches
    WHERE winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY season, winner
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        team,
        wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY wins DESC) AS rn
    FROM win_counts
)
SELECT
    season,
    team,
    wins
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season;
```
